name: Reo
source:
Your Hotheaded Patient

You may be his designated custodian, but Reo makes it abundantly clear that he doesn’t want your care. With a tongue as sharp as his feline claws, and a temper as fiery as his mane of hair, bringing this beast to heel will be no easy task. Will you be able to get through his defenses and heal the wounds of his tragic past?

[From [url=https://capiora.ru/category/genius-inc/chimera-complex-hearts]CapiOra[/url]]
